//: Serv plate reader config template. Copy to config.json and fill in.
//_secrets: config.json is git-ignored and holds live credentials. NEVER commit it.
//_coords: ALL spatial values are NORMALIZED 0.0-1.0, never pixels. See alpr.roi.
//_bench_delivery: Set false for bench tests: no backend requests, separate bounded dry-run queue.

alpr.//_pr: pr_stream is Plate Recognizer Stream. It does NOT run inference
alpr.//_pr2: in this process: a Docker container reads an RTSP feed from
alpr.//_pr3: MediaMTX and POSTs results to a loopback webhook this service
alpr.//_pr4: serves. Selecting it also switches capture to NullCamera, since
alpr.//_pr5: MediaMTX owns the sensor. See stream/ and docs/STREAM_*.md.
alpr.//_pr6: The thresholds below are on Plate Recognizer's score scale and
alpr.//_pr7: are NOT interchangeable with ultimateALPR's - swap both or
alpr.//_pr8: neither. Tag v2.1.0-ultimatealpr is the rollback point.
alpr.//license: PATH to the token FILE. Never paste the token string here.
alpr.//license_2: If set but unreadable, startup FAILS. It must not fall back
alpr.//license_3: to trial mode: trial redacts the last plate character, which
alpr.//license_4: normalize() strips, producing a confident WRONG identity.

roi.//: Where the ENGINE looks for plates (engine detect_roi).
roi.//units: NORMALIZED 0.0-1.0 fractions of frame. NOT pixels.
roi.//why: Capture resolution varies per unit and can change; a pixel box
roi.//why_2: written for one resolution silently means something else at
roi.//why_3: another, and plates just stop being detected. Converted to
roi.//why_4: pixels once, internally, from the real frame size.
roi.//default: enabled:false => full frame, identical to previous behaviour.
roi.//calibrate: Run tools/calibrate.py at the mount position to get numbers.

thresholds.//layers: TWO layers. Engine floors decide what the SDK returns;
thresholds.//layers_2: app floors decide what we trust. Separate so weak reads stay
thresholds.//layers_3: visible for calibration without being trusted. All [0,1].
thresholds.//score_type: MUST be 'min'. The SDK default is 'median', which averages
thresholds.//score_type_2: away a single misread character — the exact failure the
thresholds.//app: Applied in detector.py AFTER the engine returns.
thresholds.//app_pr: PLATE RECOGNIZER SCALE. Its scores sit far higher than
thresholds.//app_pr2: ultimateALPR's (OCR median 0.99), so the old 0.50/0.75 are
thresholds.//app_pr3: effectively no-ops: dscore p25 is 0.880 and only 2/153 reads
thresholds.//app_pr4: fell below 0.75 on labelled footage. Set from the LJS
thresholds.//app_pr6: For ultimateALPR these must go back to 0.50 / 0.75.
thresholds.//rescue: PR-only narrow recovery path: 3 exact reads from the SAME
thresholds.//rescue2: physical encounter may fail exactly one normal app gate.
thresholds.//rescue3: Both-gate failures, one/two reads, mixed strings, and reads
thresholds.//rescue4: without a stable encounter id remain misses. This is not a
thresholds.//rescue5: global threshold reduction. Set min_frames=0 to disable.
thresholds.//selected: PR Stream uses a 3s provider-side temporal window and
thresholds.//selected2: emits its selected best result. Accept that single event
thresholds.//selected3: only with normal gates, a stable vehicle encounter, >=4
thresholds.//selected4: characters, and measured rear-plate geometry. This avoids
thresholds.//selected5: globally lowering vote_min_frames, which admitted live junk.
thresholds.//high_ocr_rescue: PR-only field-calibrated exception for a selected
thresholds.//high_ocr_rescue2: result whose OCR is effectively certain but whose plate
thresholds.//high_ocr_rescue3: localization score alone missed the normal gate. It still
thresholds.//high_ocr_rescue4: requires one stable encounter, no competing text variant,
thresholds.//high_ocr_rescue5: >=4 chars, and the same rear-plate geometry safeguard.
thresholds.//settle: Vehicle-first identity: the 27 Aug field audit found two OCR
thresholds.//settle2: variants for one stopped CR-V 1.6s apart. Keep the profile
thresholds.//settle3: provisional long enough to select one identity before hashing.
thresholds.//settle4: The route trigger retains the actual board timestamp; the hash
thresholds.//settle5: is released after 3.5s quiet, bounded at 4s under continued reads.

classifiers.//profile: Chosen production profile = plates + vehicle box + colour.
classifiers.//profile_2: Measured 106 ms/frame on a Pi 5, inside the 200 ms budget.
classifiers.//heavy: These three together measured ~268 ms/frame = 3.7 fps, which
classifiers.//heavy_2: EXCEEDS the 200 ms budget. Leave off; re-measure if ever needed.

engine_advanced.//rectify: DO NOT ENABLE. Read order under rectification is unverified
engine_advanced.//rectify_2: with Doubango; it may reorder characters on the same physical
engine_advanced.//rectify_3: plate and change its hash. Hash-stability flag, not a tuning knob.
engine_advanced.//ienv: Night-vision enhancement. Also shifts vehicle box coordinates.
engine_advanced.//pyramidal: Second-pass search for small/distant plates. Costs time.
engine_advanced.//threads: -1 = auto. Explicit 4 measured no better on a Pi 5.

presence.//vote: Frames of AGREEING reads needed to confirm an identity.
presence.//vote_2: WARNING: these two keys OVERRIDE thresholds.vote_min_frames and
presence.//vote_4: Setting only the thresholds copy does nothing — that mistake
presence.//vote_5: cost a full 24-minute validation run. Change BOTH, or check the
presence.//vote_6: 'effective gates' line the service logs at startup.
presence.//vote_7: 2 for pr_stream: the LJS field eval confirmed 165/176 at two
presence.//vote_8: agreeing frames, and a third costs real plates.

dwell_zone.//: Whether a detected vehicle COUNTS as ordering. Distinct from alpr.roi:
dwell_zone.//_2: the ROI decides where the engine LOOKS, this decides what counts.
dwell_zone.//_why: Camera sits close to the menu board; exiting cars and background
dwell_zone.//_why2: road traffic are in frame and must not be counted as customers.
dwell_zone.//anchor: Which point must be inside the zone:
dwell_zone.//anchor_2: plate_center   — centre of the plate box
dwell_zone.//anchor_3: vehicle_center — centre of the vehicle box
dwell_zone.//anchor_5: and does not jitter with plate read noise.
dwell_zone.//dwell: Continuous seconds inside the zone before a confirm is allowed.
dwell_zone.//dwell_2: Time-based, not frame-count — frame counts break when fps varies.
dwell_zone.//area: Normalized vehicle-box area (fraction of frame). Depth proxy:
dwell_zone.//area_2: a car at the speaker fills far more frame than one driving past.

vehicle_only.//: LEGACY detector-side tracker, retained only for replay diagnostics.
vehicle_only.//_authority: Production disables this path and uses the presence tracker
vehicle_only.//_authority2: as the single source of vehicle lifecycle and drive-off events.
vehicle_only.//_authority3: Do not enable both paths; duplicate unidentified counts result.
vehicle_only.//_needs: Diagnostic use still requires the SDK vehicle classifier.
vehicle_only.//_move: What replaces the dwell zone as the noise filter. A car
vehicle_only.//_move2: driving the lane either crosses the frame or swells as it
vehicle_only.//_move3: approaches; a parked car does neither, however long it sits.
vehicle_only.//_move4: EITHER signal alone is enough — a car approaching head-on
vehicle_only.//_move5: grows while barely moving sideways, and requiring both would
vehicle_only.//_move6: miss it. Measured need: with no filter at all, footage with 2
vehicle_only.//_move7: plateless cars produced 20 events, one a parked car held for
vehicle_only.//_move8: 207.68s. Set both to 0 to disable filtering (diagnosis only).
vehicle_only.//_conf: App-side floor on the SDK's car-detection confidence. The
vehicle_only.//_conf2: SDK already gates at car_noplate_detect_min_score (0.8), so
vehicle_only.//_req: Opt back in to the old behaviour of requiring a calibrated
vehicle_only.//_req2: dwell zone. Leaving this true with no zone means NO missed
vehicle_only.//_req3: vehicles are counted at all — a logged warning, not silence.

dedup.//: Stops one physical car being counted as several visits.
dedup.//cooldown: Primary defence: the same hash cannot re-confirm within this
dedup.//cooldown_2: window. Independent of presence tracking, so read flicker
dedup.//absent: Legacy frame-count absence latch before a re-confirm is allowed.
dedup.//absent_s: Time-based absence requirement; more robust when fps varies.
dedup.//near: The cooldown above keys on the HASH, so it only catches an
dedup.//near_2: IDENTICAL repeat. Measured on real footage, one car gave:
dedup.//near_5: Two hashes, two visits, ONE car. This suppresses a confirm
dedup.//near_6: within N edits of one just confirmed. It is a VISIT-DEDUP
dedup.//near_7: rule only — nothing about normalization or hashing changes,
dedup.//near_match: Disabled until edit-distance suppression is constrained to one vehicle track; global fuzzy matching can merge two real cars.

presence.//shadow: Board geometry is not yet field-validated. Track and log it,
presence.//shadow2: but never turn a shadow drive-off into a production Visit.
presence.//handoff: Legacy compatibility key retained so existing unit configs and rollback builds still parse. The current Stream engine does not use speculative geometric plate handoff; only timestamp-owned native trajectories reconcile non-overlapping profiles.
presence.//board_zone: Full-width left edge: the corrected camera view places valid menu-board traffic against the far-left boundary. Keep x_max at 0.72 so upper-right pass-through traffic remains outside.

route_qualification.//: LJS full-frame review: true lane traffic first fills the lower-right foreground, then travels up/left into board_zone. Adjacent-road and drive-off traffic appears only in the upper band or exits upper-right.
route_qualification.//2: Once authoritative, every recognized or anonymous profile is held on-device until its completed native path qualifies. A plate at board_zone is provisional trigger evidence only because it can still exit upper-right. Anonymous outcomes retain the full 90-second identity-resolution window.
route_qualification.//3: 30 Aug operator labels found real drive-through vehicles false-rejected by the current geometry. Keep classification in shadow while collecting evidence; reconciliation is independent and uses timestamp-owned native trajectories, never MMC or speculative plate handoff.
route_qualification.//evidence: 27 Aug field audit: defensible lane tracks had 15-21 points over 2.4-3.2s; a manually rejected upper-right GMC crossed both broad zones in only 6 points/1.0s.
route_qualification.//board_dwell_fallback: 31 Aug field evidence: a real 42-point/29.8s menu-board truck began too near the zone boundary to clear the normal x-progress delta. This fallback still requires ordered entry then board evidence and cannot override an upper-right terminal exit.
route_qualification.//progressive_board_rescue: 1 Sep audited OR path: after upper-right exits are rejected, accept a short completed track only when it ends in a consecutive board streak and clears the normal left/up progress. A board-only track must remain wholly inside the board zone.
route_qualification.//decision_timeout: A valid 28 Aug lane trajectory arrived about 117 seconds after first recognition; 300 seconds preserves margin for long queues and delayed dwell delivery.
route_qualification.//rejection_grace: Retain rejected split-track evidence for one minute so a delayed qualified native trajectory can reconcile it before any local route diagnostic is finalized.

diagnostics.//overlay: Draw ROI + dwell zone onto the boot-time zone_preview.jpg so
diagnostics.//overlay_2: aim and config can be verified remotely in one glance.
diagnostics.//rejected: Log reads rejected by the gates, for calibration. Plate strings
diagnostics.//rejected_2: are PII-adjacent — this logs at DEBUG, never INFO in production.
diagnostics.//miss: Keep a bounded all-outcome canary dataset locally:
diagnostics.//miss_2: one FULL FRAME per confirmed plate, plate miss, or no_visible_plate vehicle.
diagnostics.//miss_3: Plate cases draw the plate bbox; vehicle-only frames remain uncropped.
diagnostics.//miss_4: A JPEG plus its JSON sidecar is one case; retain the newest 300 cases total.

thresholds.//: Legacy gate values. alpr.thresholds.app_* OVERRIDE the two per-frame
thresholds.//_2: floors below when present, so these numbers are not necessarily
thresholds.//_3: what runs. The service logs the effective gates at startup —
thresholds.//_4: grep 'effective gates' rather than reading these and assuming.
thresholds.//_group: Applied to min(det) and min(ocr) ACROSS the frames of a vote.
thresholds.//_group2: min_group_confidence is the legacy single knob and applied one
thresholds.//_group3: number to BOTH scores while sitting behind much looser
thresholds.//_group5: That asymmetry ate reads invisibly: a frame cleared the
thresholds.//_group6: per-frame gate at ocr 0.76, joined a bucket, found agreeing
thresholds.//_group7: frames, then got re-judged at 0.80 and dropped.
thresholds.//_group8: Measured on dtfootagefinal, 20 hand-labelled plated cars:
thresholds.//_group12: The third agreeing frame is what buys back the precision:
thresholds.//_group13: three independent frames reading the IDENTICAL string beats
thresholds.//_group14: a higher score on two. Explicit group floors are honored
thresholds.//_group15: and logged when stricter; check failed_group_floor telemetry.
thresholds.//_group_pr: PLATE RECOGNIZER values below. The paragraph above is the
thresholds.//_group_pr2: ultimateALPR history and is kept because the reasoning still
thresholds.//_group_pr3: applies - but its NUMBERS do not transfer. Group floors match
thresholds.//_group_pr4: the current per-frame gates (0.70/0.80). Raising the OCR floor to 0.95
thresholds.//_group_pr5: removed a no-plate-confirms-as-customer case on test footage,
thresholds.//_group_pr6: but at LJS it dropped real plates scored 0.87-0.94 exactly
thresholds.//_group_pr7: right - 94% -> 76% confirm rate. Case mix, not calibration.
thresholds.//_group_pr8: DAY ONE: if no-plate confirms appear, raise ONLY this OCR
thresholds.//_group_pr9: floor, to 0.90 before 0.95. Do not touch the fast path.
thresholds.//_vote: Frames that must independently read the IDENTICAL normalized
thresholds.//_vote2: string. 2 for pr_stream (LJS eval: 165/176 confirmable); the
thresholds.//_vote3: 3-frame setting above was tuned for ultimateALPR's clip.
thresholds.//_vote4: MUST match presence.vote_min_frames - that key OVERRIDES this
thresholds.//_vote5: one, and setting only this side is a documented way to lose a
thresholds.//_vote6: validation run. high_ocr_single_frame: when >0, one frame at or
thresholds.//_vote7: above it confirms immediately without waiting for agreement.
thresholds.//_vote8: 0.99 on PR's scale (was 0.95). The new LJS angle produces many
thresholds.//_vote9: frames, so 0.95-0.98 first hits wait for a second agreeing
thresholds.//_vote10: read instead of locking an early twin. 0.99+ single glimpses
thresholds.//_vote11: still confirm. Do not disable: some cars produce one read.

behavior.//cooldown: Revisit policy (a RETURNING customer), distinct from presence.dedup.
behavior.//pace: Legacy compatibility value; runtime pacing is capture.target_fps.
behavior.//pace_2: At 5 fps the loop budget is 200ms. Field-test temperature and
behavior.//pace_3: throttling on each hardware/cooling combination before raising fps.

detection_zone.//: Full-left plate-identity eligibility region. The corrected camera view
detection_zone.//_2: can place a valid plate against the left boundary; y_max still excludes
detection_zone.//_3: the near-field bottom band. The ordered route can exclude cross
detection_zone.//_4: traffic only after shadow validation and promotion; it does not
detection_zone.//_5: protect this live plate gate while shadowed. Images stay full-frame.

hours.//_3: start warmup_minutes before open. Omit this block to stay
